group: Pre‑walk listener returns true – validator executed

cases.expected: The validator’s walk() method is invoked. If it returns a non‑empty Set, those ValidationMessage objects are present in the Set returned by JsonSchema.walk(). Post‑walk listeners are invoked exactly once after the validator execution.
cases.description: Pre‑walk listener signals SKIP = false, therefore the validator is executed. The test supplies a validator that returns a Set containing a single ValidationMessage. The test asserts that the returned error Set contains that message and that post‑walk listeners have been called.

cases.expected: The validator’s walk() method is invoked with shouldValidateSchema = false. Returned errors are added to the final Set. Post‑walk listeners are invoked.
cases.description: Same as the previous case but the boolean flag is false, ensuring the flag is correctly propagated to the validator.

group: Pre‑walk listener returns false – validator skipped

cases.expected: Validator.walk() is never invoked. The returned Set is empty. Post‑walk listeners are still invoked exactly once.
cases.description: The pre‑walk listener signals SKIP = true, therefore the validator must be bypassed. The test verifies that no validator interaction occurs, the final error Set is empty and the post‑walk listener is still called.

group: Validator returns null – no errors added

cases.expected: Validator.walk() returns null. The final Set returned by JsonSchema.walk() is empty. Post‑walk listeners are invoked.
cases.description: Ensures that a null result from a validator does not cause a NullPointerException and does not contribute any ValidationMessage to the final Set.

group: Validator returns empty Set – no errors added

cases.expected: Validator.walk() returns an empty Set. JsonSchema.walk() returns an empty Set. Post‑walk listeners are invoked exactly once.
cases.description: Verifies that an empty result from a validator does not affect the final error collection.

cases.expected: Both validators are executed (pre‑walk listeners return false). Their non‑empty result Sets are merged; the final Set contains all ValidationMessage objects from both validators. Post‑walk listeners are invoked for each validator.
cases.description: Checks that JsonSchema.walk() correctly iterates over all registered validators, aggregates distinct ValidationMessage objects, and still calls post‑walk listeners after each validator.

group: Validator throws exception – post‑walk still invoked

cases.expected: Validator.walk() throws a RuntimeException. The exception propagates out of JsonSchema.walk(). Despite the exception, the post‑walk listener is still executed exactly once before the exception bubbles up.
cases.description: Ensures that the finally block guarantees post‑walk listener execution even when a validator fails with an exception, and that the exception is not swallowed.
The JsonSchema instance is constructed with a null ValidationContext. When walk() accesses validationContext.getConfig(), a NullPointerException is thrown.

group: Null Config in ValidationContext causes NullPointerException

group: Pre‑walk listener throws RuntimeException – post‑walk still invoked

group: Post‑walk listener throws RuntimeException – exception propagates

cases.description: The post‑walk listener (runPostWalkListeners) throws a RuntimeException. The exception should bubble out of JsonSchema.walk() (the finally block does not swallow it).
